name: structural-claiming
body: The claim and scope boundary of the structural scanner: it skips code-frontend-claimed extensions, honours the standard exclusions (gitignore-aware path filtering, `target`/`node_modules`, `--exclude-path`), and applies the `apg/config.json` include/exclude scope plus the structural `code_type`. Reuses the existing classification machinery (`rust.apg.classify`, `rust.apg.git.path_is_ignored`) and the ingestor's claim/blacklist boundary (`rust.apg.ingest.claim`, `rust.apg.ingest.is_blacklisted`).
